newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms Jan-Aug net dips to PLN 6.6 bln.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms Jan-Aug net dips to PLN 6.6 bln.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 6.6 billion zloty net profit in the January-August period, compared with a 6.7 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
GUS said the private sector had a net profit of 3.7 billion zlotys on total revenues of 164.7 billion in the period against a profit of 2.4 billion and sales of 108.5 in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 2.9 billion on sales of 171.7 billion versus last year's 4.3 billion and 150.2 billion respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
